# Source attribution

The training sample originates from IBM's archived
`telco-customer-churn-on-icp4d` repository:
https://github.com/IBM/telco-customer-churn-on-icp4d .

The original repository license is reproduced in `IBM_SOURCE_LICENSE.txt`.
The sample scoring rows, held-out scores and split identifiers are derived
from that public sample. The application code was authored separately for
this portfolio. The raw source CSV is downloaded separately and is not
included in the release archive. See `DATA_CARD.md` for source checksums,
transformations and limitations.
